example_sentences_in_bangla: এসব গাঁজাখুরি কথা কেউ বিশ্বাস করবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: His story is nothing but a tall tale.
Nobody will believe such cock and bull stories.
history: The idiom originates from the hallucinatory effects of ganja (cannabis), implying stories as unreal as drug-induced visions in rural Bengali folklore.
note: Often used to dismiss implausible narratives in everyday speech.
